content.short: A community-focused investment club offering insights on trading/investing in crypto, forex, and the US stock.
content.description: Alpha Surfers began minting in March 2023. We are an alpha group and an investment club. Our primary goal is to deliver value and rewards to our holders. We do that by offering insights and discussions in CNFT projects, Cardano projects, and trading/investing in crypto, forex, Cardano Native Tokens, upcoming IDO/ICOs, and the US stock market. The motto here is that a rising tide lifts all boats. The Alpha Surfers NFT serves as a lifetime digital membership to the group, and unlocks holder-only channels.
content.meta: Find out about Alpha Surfers Prime (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
